paragraphs.text: Bright-Palm , Soul Awakener , is a kitsune shaman of Kamigawa .

Bright-Palm is a kitsune shaman. One of the cleverest young minds of Kamigawa, Bright-Palm studied under Regent Light-Paws until she was unwittingly trapped in the spirit realm. Before she escaped from the realm years later, she learned to harness the power of the kami around her. With the onset of the New Phyrexian Invasion , Bright-Palm held the front lines.
